dimensions.assessment: Affects current servicemembers and veterans participating in the Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance and Veterans' Group Life Insurance programs.
dimensions.evidence: Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance program and the Veterans' Group Life Insurance program

dimensions.assessment: Mandates periodic reviews and reporting by the VA to serve as a guide for potential administrative coverage increases, without directly altering benefit payouts on its own.
dimensions.evidence: complete a review... and submit... the results of the review, which may serve as a guide for coverage increases

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative duties on the Department of Veterans Affairs to perform reviews, but does not state specific funding appropriations or direct spending changes.
dimensions.evidence: require the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to periodically review the automatic maximum coverage

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code to add a new reporting and review requirement for federal life insurance programs.
dimensions.evidence: amended by adding at the end the following new section: Sec. 1980B. Periodic review of automatic maximum coverage

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory requirement for reviews to be conducted every five years starting on January 1, 2026.
dimensions.evidence: On January 1, 2026, and every five years thereafter, the Secretary shall complete a review

importance_detail.rationale: The law requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to conduct periodic five-year reviews comparing maximum life insurance coverage amounts to changes in the Consumer Price Index.
